description: Header file defining a template class 'transform_view' for transforming ranges via a predicate, including iterator implementation and a helper function 'transform'.

classes.name: transform_view
classes.description: A template class that provides a view transforming elements of a range using a predicate.

classes.name: iter_impl
classes.description: An internal iterator implementation class used by 'transform_view' to iterate over transformed elements.

methods.name: transform_view
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view with a range and a transformation predicate.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the transformed range.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the transformed range.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Helper function to create a 'transform_view' from a range and a predicate.
